weeks.title: Readiness Diagnostic & Algebra I Bridge
weeks.essential_question: Which prerequisite skills are secure, and which require targeted review before advanced work?

weeks.title: Advanced Functions, Transformations & Inverses · Part 1
weeks.essential_question: How do notation, transformations, composition, and inverse thinking reveal the structure and behavior of functions?

weeks.essential_question: How do notation, transformations, composition, and inverse thinking reveal the structure and behavior of functions?
weeks.focus: Function Composition & Decomposition; Inverse Functions & One-to-One Relationships; Piecewise, Absolute-Value & Step Functions

weeks.title: Polynomial Functions & Complex Numbers · Part 1
weeks.essential_question: How do polynomial structure, complex numbers, zeros, and end behavior work together to describe nonlinear change?

weeks.title: Polynomial Functions & Complex Numbers · Part 2
weeks.essential_question: How do polynomial structure, complex numbers, zeros, and end behavior work together to describe nonlinear change?

weeks.title: Polynomial Functions & Complex Numbers · Part 3
weeks.essential_question: How do polynomial structure, complex numbers, zeros, and end behavior work together to describe nonlinear change?
weeks.focus: Quadratic Equations with Complex Solutions; Conjugates, Modulus & the Complex Plane; Fundamental Theorem of Algebra & Complete Factorization

weeks.title: Polynomial Equations, Division & Graphs · Part 1
weeks.essential_question: How can division, factor relationships, multiplicity, and graph features expose every important part of a polynomial model?

weeks.essential_question: How can division, factor relationships, multiplicity, and graph features expose every important part of a polynomial model?

weeks.essential_question: How can division, factor relationships, multiplicity, and graph features expose every important part of a polynomial model?

weeks.essential_question: How do excluded values, asymptotes, holes, and rates of change shape rational expressions and models?

weeks.essential_question: How do repeated multiplication, percent change, and continuous growth create exponential patterns and decisions?
